newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cossack back to 80,000 bpd - Woodside.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cossack back to 80,000 bpd - Woodside.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Thursday the Cossack Pioneer oil platform offshore Western Australia was producing crude oil at the rate of about 80,000 barrels per day (bpd) following repairs to a gas export system.
A Woodside spokesman told Reuters that in the next few weeks oil production is expected to be gradually increased toward the faciliity's design capacity of around 115,000 bpd.
"We're still fine tuning the modifications," he said from Perth.
Production had declined to about 50,000 bpd in early October to allow for repairs to the system.
